spec.name: Tafraoute Almond Blossom Festival
spec.description: Celebration of the almond bloom in Tafraoute, the heart of Morocco's almond country in the Anti-Atlas. Amazigh music and dance, local crafts and almond specialties mark the short window when the valleys turn white and pink.

recurrence.note: Timing follows the almond bloom, which shifts with the weather each year
